target_customer: Software engineers and engineering teams that need to understand and document large codebases
problem: Engineers lose a large share of time reading and navigating unfamiliar code; architecture knowledge is not shared or kept current.
business_model: Freemium developer tool with paid tier for architecture diagrams and team features
product_category: Developer tools, code visualization and architecture diagrams

founders.name: Liam Prevelige
founders.background_notes: Full name taken from LinkedIn URL on YC page; YC page gives first name only.

founders.name: William McCall
founders.background_notes: Full name inferred from LinkedIn URL on YC page; YC page says Will.

competitors.name: CodeSee
competitors.what: Code visualization and codebase maps, with natural language queries added in July 2023
competitors.funding_then: 3M USD seed in 2021 and 7M USD secondary seed in Jan 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Call graphs built on existing language servers are accessible; generating accurate architecture models with LLMs is harder.

defensibility.rationale: VS Code extension built on language servers and LLMs; AI coding assistants can add similar views.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources; company still listed as active.

market_need_then: The company cites that most developer time goes to reading code (75 percent per the YC description, self reported). Launch HN in Aug 2024 and a Product Hunt launch on 2024-09-10 show developer interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses codeviz.ai; parent company is EdisonLabs, Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benefit focused, for example 'Get 30 minutes back. Every day.'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Code architecture in one clear view
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post in Aug 2024 and Product Hunt launch; a later Show HN post exists (date not given).

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name that blends with other code visualization products; launches drew attention but no sourced brand coverage.

pivots.from: VS Code extension with call graph and C4 view
pivots.to: collaborative diagram editor for teams with C4 and UML
pivots.why: Later Show HN describes team use for shared context and PR visualization; date not given.

outcome_analysis: CodeViz is a two person YC S24 developer tool that began as a VS Code extension and now sells team architecture diagrams. It has launch traction and claims large user numbers, but no verified funding round or revenue figure is public, so its outcome is unresolved.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (Extruct, VCBacked, Caplight) list 500K USD pre-seed dated 2024-09-25 from YC; no press release, so not recorded as a round. Founders' full names inferred from LinkedIn URLs in the YC page. Team size on YC says 2 while the long description says founded by two ex-Tesla engineers. Website claims of OpenAI, Anthropic and other users are self reported. Search results mention an embedded Dealroom style instruction elsewhere only in the CoCrafter search, not here.
